system.description: After imbibing blood laced with laudanum (suffering the Negative Trait Lethargic for the following scene), the thaumaturge smears a trace of blood upon a victim's skin, robbing her of the ability to heal wounds through vitae for the rest of the evening. The victim may spend a Willpower Trait to negate the effect for one turn, and may not be aware of the curse until she attempts to heal.
